title: glib: unsoundness in VariantStrIter iterator impls
evidence: glib 0.18.5 (Linux only, via Tauri's GTK3/webkit2gtk stack); fixed in glib 0.20
fix: Blocked upstream: Tauri 2 pins gtk-rs 0.18. Consilium doesn't use VariantStrIter. Re-check when Tauri moves to GTK4/gtk-rs 0.20+.

title: Fixed CLI turn deadline interrupts ongoing tool work
evidence: A Claude turn reached the 900-second absolute deadline despite producing a tool result about three minutes before expiry; the generic timeout discarded the activity context.
fix: Use a 900-second inactivity budget renewed only by recognized provider activity, retain a 3600-second total runtime cap and Stop cleanup, and report the last activity. Policy tests pass; native runner tests, peer review and three-platform CI pending.
